_comment: Redacted shape of ~/.dontpanic/adapters.json after running the printing-press-adapter F003 dogfood for Linear. Operator copies this to ~/.dontpanic/adapters.json (gitignored) and replaces <paste-your-token> placeholders in the per-service config (see linear-config-example.json) with real credentials. The wrapper module's register_adapter() will idempotently insert the 'linear' entry below on first import; pre-existing operator entries are preserved.
